proposal.reason: The main functional change is CI workflow behavior: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds authenticated registry pulls, branch-aware pccl-tests revision resolution/fallback, and dispatch-label time pinning for built commits/tests; .github/workflows/source-sanity.yml and pccl-daily-full.yml propagate that resolved runner revision through checkout, cache/probe/validate, and gating logic. Evidence for ci: .github/workflows/scripts/pccl_for_test_hggcrt13_ubuntu24_build.sh changes CI build-pass sequencing and unsets LDFLAGS for the test pass to restore unit-test linking, while .github/xtest/artifact_cache.py and test_workflow_contract.py update fixture-runner revision contract checks used by workflow validation.
